redFirst.basis: Regression task with tests.expectRedFirst false, and what was wrong was the fixture, not the driver. HEAD's driver plus this test file is the shape that already passes, so a red-first run at HEAD has no red to find. To show the new assertions can fail, I mutated a throwaway copy of tests/ in the scratchpad (plugins/ and tools/ symlinked), never the worktree. (a) _auto_wave_member pointed every member at one shared marks/shared.log: --stage au30-block exit 1, 'FAIL au31 FAIL au31c', 'SELFTEST FAILED: 7/9 cases passed'. (b) _auto_marks with its directory branch removed: exit 1, 'FAIL au31', '8/9 cases passed'. Purged __pycache__ before each run; the copy was then removed.
redFirst.at: not run through the helper; the mutation runs were made 2026-11-18 in the scratchpad copy

outcome.technical: Only tests/test_drive_phase.py changes; nothing under plugins/. (1) _auto_marks(where) now takes one mark file, a list of them, or a directory holding one per child, and returns their lines in file-name order, each file in write order. The old file reader became _auto_mark_lines. Its docstring says which cases need which: every case of _auto_cases, and au36/au37, run their commands one after another and share one file, whose order they assert; au30, au30b and au31 are wave members started together by auto_run, so each gets a file of its own. (2) _auto_wave_member treats `marks` as a directory and gives each member <dir>/<subject>.log. (3) _auto_clear also empties a directory of mark files. (4) _auto_wave_cases now makes root/marks as a directory for the wave members and root/marks.log (`serial`) for au36/au37, which run one command per step. (5) au31 still asserts sorted marks == ['0 first', '0 second'] by value, and now also that P1.1's file holds ['0 first'] and P1.2's holds ['0 second']. (6) New case au31c reads the mark paths off the wave step's own `runs`, by shlex-splitting each command and taking argv[3], and asserts two distinct files whose marks read together are the two the wave wrote. Every other case keeps its expectations unchanged. Class sweep (every append-mode child script in the suite): WS_LOG (_WRITER_STUB) is written by sessions run one at a time via subprocess.run, both in _play_session and in _auto_process. Each _auto_real_cases repo has a single task. DRIVE_CWD_LOG (_CWD_LOG) is written only by P1.1's gate under a serial `next` loop. LP_PROBE_LOG has one probe per run. owner.log is per tree. All were left alone because their writers do not run at the same time. Reproduction: two python processes each appending 3000 lines to one file with open(...,'a') kept 6000 of 6000 lines, in two rounds two seconds apart, because O_APPEND is atomic on macOS. So the Windows lost line is not shown on this machine; the fix was made on the fixture's shape. Gate: `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test_drive_phase.py` exit 0, '1/1 files ok, 1009 cases'. Direct run `--selftest --stage au30-block --stage au-block`: exit 0, 'ALL PASS: 24/24 cases passed', au31c among them. ruff check tests/test_drive_phase.py exit 0. Dependants: tests/test_drive_without_model.py imports _Env, _base_mark, _base_measure_repo and others, none changed; a grep of tests, tools, plugins and .github finds the _auto_* mark helpers only in this file, so it is still correct. tests/test_stamp_verification.py uses _actions, unchanged, so still correct. The staged table is unchanged: au-block and au30-block each reach the helpers at module level, and the sweep's run of every block passed. .github/sweep-costs.json, ci.yml, drive-phase.py, tests/test__runner_output.py, tests/test_run_test_gate.py and tools/affected.py name this file by path only; its path and its block labels are unchanged, so all are still correct.
outcome.descriptive: The wave cases in the drive suite give each concurrent member its own mark file, so two children appending at once can no longer lose a line and turn au31 red on Windows.

testsAdded: au31 now asserts each wave member's mark from its own file (P1.1 -> ['0 first'], P1.2 -> ['0 second']) as well as the combined marks by value
au31c: the two members of a concurrent wave are handed two distinct mark files, read off the step's own runs, and those files together hold both marks
